To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the spatial autoregressive parameter in the spatial dynamic panel model is statistically and economically significant; (2) there is evidence of conditional convergence in the European regions, but this convergence is affected by spatial disparities; (3) the spatial dynamic panel GMM estimator performs better than the Arellano-Bond estimator in the sense of efficiency and robustness.

(1) the spatial dynamic panel GMM estimator is robust to spatial autocorrelation in the errors, but not to spatial autocorrelated regressors; (2) spatial autocorrelation is an issue in the estimation of spatial dynamic panels; and (3) there is empirical evidence of conditional spatial convergence in Europe.
